scope: Four new immutable key snapshot tests plus four existing real SDK tests. Actual ephemeral signatures validate overlap, issuance/verification and snapshot windows, copied inputs, replacement removal and digest identity. No trusted distribution/rollback protection, runtime factory/reload or current service/subject authorization evidence.
